exposure: HbA1c levels after 24 weeks of pregnancy
outcome: pregnancy outcome (gestational age at delivery, mode of delivery, birth weight, neonatal hypoglycemia, NICU admissions, neonate’s condition at discharge)
cohort: 60 healthy pregnant women between 18-35 years old without gestational diabetes or overt diabetes.
finding: There was no significant relationship found between HbA1c levels after 24 weeks of pregnancy and pregnancy outcomes in women without gestational diabetes.
